description: A raw object removed from the CAS by an actor whose cited authority covers this Kind (on a fresh chain, the retention key endorsed by the node key at event 10); a public-record object can never be expired.

claims: at the recorded position on the chain, the object at this address was uncited by any admitted spec, resolution manifest, event payload, or specAddress, and was removed by an actor whose cited authority covered this Kind
doesNotClaim: that the bytes never existed or were never read
